title: Courthouse Wedding in NYC: Real Cost & Steps (2026)
description: Courthouse wedding in New York: $60 in fees: license $35 + ceremony $25, per the official pages. Wait, ID and booking steps. Checked Oct 28, 2026.
refresh_note: Courthouse pages are re-checked every 3 months.
answer_html:
As of Oct 28, 2026, a courthouse wedding in New York costs $60 in official fees: $35 for the marriage license (NYC City Clerk) and $25 for the civil ceremony (City Clerk's office, any borough).

facts_heading: The fees and the steps, from the official pages
facts_intro: Copied word for word from NYC City Clerk. Each row links to the page it came from.

facts.label: Marriage license fee
facts.quote: The fee for a Marriage License is $35.

facts.label: Civil ceremony at the City Clerk's office (any borough)
facts.quote: The cost is $25, payable by credit/debit card or money order.

facts.label: Waiting period
facts.display: 24 hours after you receive the license
facts.quote: The marriage ceremony needs to take place at least 24 hours after you receive the License.

facts.label: How long the license is valid
facts.display: Usually 60 days (180 days for active military)
facts.quote: Marriage Licenses are usually valid for 60 days. For active military personnel, the License is valid for 180 days.

facts.label: ID you bring
facts.display: The same type of photo ID you used for the license: you, your spouse and a witness
facts.quote: You, your prospective spouse, and at least one witness must bring the same type of photo identification that was used to obtain the Marriage License.

facts.label: How to get the license / book the ceremony
facts.display: Appointment only, online (Project Cupid, nyc.gov/cupid) or by phone; no walk-ins
facts.quote: City Clerk offices do not provide walk-in services. You must make an appointment online or by phone.

facts.label: Ceremony group size
facts.display: No more than 6 attendees including the couple and the witness
facts.quote: There can be no more than 6 attendees, including you, your prospective spouse and the witness.

facts.label: Ceremony arrival hours
facts.display: Arrive between 8:30 AM and 3:15 PM, Monday to Friday
facts.quote: You, your prospective spouse, and witness should arrive between 8:30 AM and 3:15 PM, Monday through Friday.

facts.label: Witness
facts.quote: At least one witness over the age of 18

facts.label: Marriage certificate after a City Clerk ceremony
facts.quote: Once the civil marriage ceremony is complete, you will get a Marriage Certificate on that same day.

facts.label: License the same day
facts.display: You leave with the license the same day if your documents are complete
facts.quote: If you provide all necessary documents, you will get a Marriage License on the same day.

facts.label: Marrying inside the 24-hour wait
facts.display: A Judicial Waiver from the County Clerk, no fee
facts.quote: You can request a Judicial Waiver from the County Clerk in the borough where you obtained your Marriage License. There is no fee.

steps: Book your appointment: City Clerk offices take no walk-ins, so you make an appointment online through Project Cupid (nyc.gov/cupid) or by phone.
Both of you go to a City Clerk borough office with valid photo ID and the $35 fee (card or money order); with complete documents you get the license the same day.
Wait at least 24 hours after you receive the license before the ceremony (a judge's waiver is possible, no fee). The license is usually valid for 60 days.
Book the City Clerk ceremony ($25) at any of the five borough offices and arrive between 8:30 AM and 3:15 PM, Monday to Friday.
Bring the license, at least one witness over 18 and the same type of photo ID used for the license; no more than 6 attendees in all.
After the ceremony you receive your Marriage Certificate the same day.

faq.q: How do you get married at a courthouse in New York City?
faq.a: Make an appointment online through Project Cupid or by phone (City Clerk offices take no walk-ins), then go to a borough office with valid photo ID and the $35 fee. After the 24-hour wait, book the $25 City Clerk ceremony at any of the five borough offices and bring at least one witness over 18.

faq.q: How much does a courthouse wedding cost in NYC?
faq.a: As of Oct 28, 2026, the City Clerk charges $35 for the marriage license and $25 for the civil ceremony, $60 in all. Both figures come from the City's own NYC311 pages linked in the table.

faq.q: How many people are allowed in a courthouse wedding in NYC?
faq.a: The City Clerk's ceremony page says no more than 6 attendees, including the couple and the witness. For a bigger party, see the small-venue prices on our NYC venues page, from $595.

faq.q: How quickly can I get married in NYC?
faq.a: With complete documents you leave the City Clerk office with the $35 license the same day, but the ceremony must be at least 24 hours after you receive it. A judicial waiver from the County Clerk can allow a ceremony inside that wait, with no fee.

faq.q: Is it cheaper to get married at a courthouse?
faq.a: The City Clerk's fees total $60. The lowest price we verified for a small venue in NYC is $595 (Occasions Hall (Queens Party Hall)), so the courthouse is the cheaper start; compare both pages before you decide.
